definitions.explanation: The style or design of written or printed characters.

examples.japanese: この{字体|じたい}は{読|よ}みにくい。
examples.english: This font is hard to read.

examples.japanese: {明朝体|みんちょうたい}という{字体|じたい}がよく{使|つか}われる。
examples.english: The Mincho typeface is often used.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{字体|じたい}で{名刺|めいし}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made a business card with a new font.

notes:
{字体|じたい} refers to the visual style of characters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {字体|じたい}を{変|か}える (to change the font)
- {明朝体|みんちょうたい} (Mincho typeface - serif)
- ゴシック{体|たい} (Gothic typeface - sans-serif)
- {楷書体|かいしょたい} (standard script style)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {字体|じたい}: font/typeface (character style)
- フォント: font (borrowed from English, common in computing)
- {書体|しょたい}: typeface, writing style

HOMOPHONES:
- {字体|じたい}: font, typeface
- {辞退|じたい}: refusal, declining
